definitions: Engaging in a futile argument with an irrational person.
Attempting to reason with someone who is incapable of rational thought or unwilling to engage in a logical discussion.
A pointless endeavor where one party cannot or will not understand the other's perspective.
examples: Trying to explain the new policy to him is like you may as well play chess with a pigeon; he just won't listen.
Arguing with my brother about politics is like you may as well play chess with a pigeon.
When it comes to certain topics, you may as well play chess with a pigeon with some people.
source: you may as well play chess with a pigeon
